dataset.description: This project involves the research of climate and energy policy measure effects by defining causalities between economic, social and other factors.

distribution.title: For the fulfilment of the project goal (defining causalities of climate and energy policy planning), the project involves the collection and analysis of causalities included in empirical research papers, as well as causalities indicators and indicator data (all hereinafter - the data). The data will be sourced from international research papers, as well as national statistical office of the Republic of Latvia.

dmp.description: The Data Management Plan describes what kind of data will be collected, processed, and synthesized, and which methodology and standards will be applied during the data collection and handling processes. It elaborates the procedures for sharing and open access to the data, as well as for curation and preservation of the data. Furthermore, it defines the procedure that the exchange of data in project will be in full compliance with EU and national legislation, as well as with internal data protection strategies and RTU ethics code. This is a first version of the DMP which describes the procedures. During the project it will be updated with all relevant documentations for the data collections.
